Usage: astryx experimental icon add [options] [export]

[experimental] Register one icon you chose from a library in your icon set

Options:
  --from <module>          The module the icon is exported from: a package, a subpath, or a ./ path to a file inside this package
  --definition <name>      Map the icon to this icon definition
  --new-definition <name>  Add your set's own definition, named in camelCase (aiHelper) or kebab-case (ai-helper), then map the icon to it; needs --description and --words
  --description <text>     With --new-definition: what the icon is for
  --words <list>           With --new-definition: comma-separated words people search for
  --default                The module's default export is the icon; your set's module must re-export it under <export>
  --variant <name>         Add the export as this variant of an existing icon: one of the set's declared variants, such as solid
  --all                    With --variant and --from, and no export: add that variant for every icon whose id the module exports, in one run
  --id <id>                The icon's id, instead of the one its name gives
  --set <name>             The set to edit, when the package ships several
  -h, --help               display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the icon is added, already present, or the matching definitions are listed
  1  the export is missing or is data, the definition is unknown, the id is taken, or the variant is not one the set declares

Examples:
  # Which definitions fit
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon add Bin --from @acme/glyph-library
  # Add and map
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon add Bin --from @acme/glyph-library --definition delete
  # Add the solid variant of every icon
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon add --variant solid --from @heroicons/react/24/solid --all
  # Add your own definition
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon add Dice5 --from @acme/glyph-library --new-definition random --description 'Pick something at random.' --words dice,shuffle,chance
  # Add a solid variant
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon add Bin --from @acme/glyph-library/solid --id bin --variant solid

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon-add
